'''Freddy''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a radio guest in [[Grand Theft Auto III]] and [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City]] and in a radio advert in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. His voice actor is not credited.

==Character history==
Freddy is a [[United Kingdom|British]] man who, by [[1986]], had moved to [[Vice City in GTA III Era|Vice City]]. He calls into [[K-Chat]] and asks [[Gethsemanee Starhawk Moonmaker]] to spank him. He later leaves Vice City and opens up his own nanny service, [[Hampshire Nannies]], in [[1992]] and by [[2001]] moves to [[Liberty City in GTA III Era|Liberty City]]. In October 2001 he calls [[Chatterbox FM|Chatterbox]] host [[Lazlow Jones|Lazlow]] and asks about nannies and stating that needs to be spanked.
